title: Seldon ledger event
description: One line of ledger/YYYY-MM.jsonl. The same shape appears in index.events, where resolutions are folded onto their target as resolution, resolutionDetail and (when linked) case (ADR-0012 §8, §11).

ts.description: RFC 3339 with offset; the offset of the source is kept (pacman.log may say +00:00 or +02:00)

subject.description: package name, path (~-relative), theme slug, plugin id, snapshot number, case id (case-*), program name (command), 'journal' (note without case), 'state-reset' (state-loss), or the target's subject (resolution, correction)

explicit.description: pacman: named on the command line

txId.description: pacman: opaque transaction id, shared by the package lines of one transaction; a file pacman left (a pacman note) carries it as meta.transaction instead (ADR-0042)

resolution.description: ledger: only on kind resolution; index: folded onto the target event. `linked` by `system`: SPEC-ENGINE §5 rule 9

resolutionDetail.description: index only (ADR-0012 §11): the detail of the winning resolution, folded onto its target next to resolution; never in a ledger line (a resolution line carries it as detail)

enabled.description: plugin-add, plugin-enable, plugin-disable: whether the plugin is enabled after the change (ADR-0012 §15)

txId.description: resolution only: the txId of the drift group this line was written for; every member's resolution line of one write carries it (ADR-0013 §4)

risk.description: case-created, case-started, case-updated: the case's risk after the event (ADR-0035 §1); required on case-updated, absent on lines written before contract 2

truncated.description: index only: a text of this event was clipped (ADR-0025, ADR-0035 §3); never in a ledger line

txStatus.description: pacman, on every package line of a transaction that did not complete (ADR-0043): pacman logged `transaction failed` or `transaction interrupted`, or no end line (unfinished); absent when it completed and on lines written before ADR-0043

meta.description: Conventional keys: command (redacted command line), version (install/remove/reinstall, plugin-add), from/to (upgrade, downgrade, update, plugin-update, theme-set), hashFrom/hashTo (config-*), type (snapper: single|pre|post), cleanup (snapper), pairOf (snapper post: number of its pre), enabled (plugin-add/-enable/-disable), txId (resolution of a drift group), transaction (pacman note: the txId of the transaction that left the file, ADR-0042), risk (case-created/-started/-updated), sources/files (state-loss), txStatus (pacman: a transaction that did not complete), truncated (index only)
